coverage.summary: Applies to most residential rentals, including mobile homes. Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are exempt unless the tenant makes the law apply by written request to the landlord.
coverage.owner_conditions: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are exempt. A tenant there may make the law apply 30 days after sending the landlord a written request.
coverage.other_conditions: The deposit investment and account section does not apply to seasonal rentals. A seasonal rental is a term of not more than 125 consecutive days by a person with a permanent residence elsewhere.

result.notes: landlord_size_condition was set to null. The 10-or-more-units rule only gives landlords a choice of where to invest deposits (a money market fund instead of a bank). That is landlord conduct, not a condition on which buildings, units or owners the law covers. other_conditions was narrowed: the guide says the seasonal exclusion applies to the deposit/investment section, and it does not clearly extend it to the interest provisions. The opt-in wording was kept close to the guide's text.
